# Two things the element wildcard has to get right, neither of which any
# testdata fixture reached.
#
# 1. A wildcard prop is a map of the names it collected, not a name of its own.
#    Three sites turn props into attributes -- static markup, the route-mode
#    skeleton, and the DOM writes a node inside a `for` or a reactive slot
#    takes. The third wrote the map itself, so a looped checkbox got an
#    attribute called "attrs" holding "[object Map]" and no type at all, and
#    rendered as a text box.
#
# 2. The tag and attribute patterns are lowercase-INITIAL, not all-lowercase.
#    SVG's vocabulary is camelCase inside foreign content, so an all-lowercase
#    pattern rejects viewBox, linearGradient, clipPath and feGaussianBlur --
#    every one of which is a real element or attribute.

sngl generate --platform=html --lang=none --out=out loop.sngl
exists out/index.html

# The map is unpacked into one attribute per name it collected.
grep 'setAttribute\("type", "checkbox"\)' out/index.html
! grep 'setAttribute\("attrs"' out/index.html
! grep 'object Map' out/index.html

sngl generate --platform=html --lang=none --out=svgout svg.sngl
exists svgout/index.html

# A camelCase tag and a camelCase attribute both survive to the markup.
grep '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24">' svgout/index.html
grep '<linearGradient id="g">' svgout/index.html

# A leading capital is still a misspelling rather than an element nobody has
# standardised: that is what the lowercase-initial rule is for.
! sngl check bad.sngl
stderr 'unknown component "Boxthing"'

-- loop.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"

component main {
    var items = ["a", "b"]
    var on = false
    vbox {
        for it = items {
            checkbox(label=it, checked=on)
        }
    }
}
-- svg.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"
import html "sngl://platforms/html"

component main {
    platform html {
        html.svg(viewBox="0 0 24 24") {
            html.linearGradient(id="g") {}
        }
    }
}
-- bad.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"
import html "sngl://platforms/html"

component main {
    platform html {
        Boxthing(id="x") {}
    }
}
